src/auth.py:
"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import hmac
import secrets


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Build a signed, HTTP-only session cookie carrying no user-visible token."""
    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    signature = hmac.new(
        secret.encode("utf-8"), session_id.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256
    ).hexdigest()

    return {
        "session_id": session_id,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "cookie": {
            "name": "session",
            "value": f"{session_id}.{signature}",
            "http_only": True,
            "secure": True,
            "same_site": "Lax",
            "path": "/",
        },
    }
src/sessions.py:
"""User-session persistence boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
from typing import Any


class SessionStore:
    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "sessions.db") -> None:
        self._conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        self._conn.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions ("
            "session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL)"
        )
        self._conn.commit()

    def save(self, session_id: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self._conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sessions (session_id, payload) VALUES (?, ?) "
            "ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET payload = excluded.payload",
            (session_id, json.dumps(payload)),
        )
        self._conn.commit()

    def load(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        row = self._conn.execute(
            "SELECT payload FROM sessions WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        return json.loads(row[0]) if row else None
